verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="lib/journey-plans.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(p))process.exit(79);const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const i=s.indexOf("export async function forkPlan(");if(i<0)process.exit(79);const j=s.indexOf("\nexport ",i+10);const body=s.slice(i,j<0?s.length:j);if(!/block_type|parent_id|copyItemTree/.test(body)){console.error("SCAN-727: forkPlan copies only practice_id, domain_id, sort_order, note and cadence, so Remix on a phase or lesson Journey produces a flat list of untitled empty practice blocks.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: forkPlan and duplicatePlan share copyItemTree, which copies the full block tree parents first; a priced or tier-gated source forks without bodies or media; a partial copy deletes the fork and returns null.
